supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: brow ridge extension is clearly visible beyond the lateral ocular boundaries

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between the light-colored muzzle area and the dark-pigmented cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick lower lip with visible structural droop and vertical exposure

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: small, light-colored depigmentation spots or scarring across the muzzle skin
other_distinctive_markers: lower teeth visible due to partially open mouth posture
